text: Use this to search or list all workers in Workday. User says: list all employees, search for a worker, find employee by name, get all staff, show workers, fetch employee list, search people, who works here, show terminated employees. Needs: nothing required; search (name filter), includeTerminatedWorkers, limit, offset are optional. NOT for: a specific worker's profile, pay, time off, org, or history — those need a workerID and use separate endpoints. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: collection.

Use this to retrieve a single worker's profile or details by their Workday ID. User says: get employee details, fetch worker profile, who is this employee, show me worker info, get my own profile, lookup a specific person, retrieve worker by ID. Use 'me' as ID for self-lookup. Needs: workerID (required). NOT for: pay slips, time off plans, time off entries, org structure, history, direct reports, inbox tasks — those are all separate sub-resource endpoints. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: single.

Use this to get a full list of historical events or audit trail for a specific worker. User says: show worker history, employee audit trail, list all changes for employee, what happened to this worker over time, worker event log, employment history events, change log for person. Needs: workerID (required), limit and offset optional. NOT for: a single specific history item (use history subresourceID endpoint), job changes, business title changes. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: collection.

Use this to retrieve one specific history event for a worker by its event ID. User says: get this specific history record, fetch one history item for employee, retrieve a particular audit event by ID, look up a single history entry. Needs: workerID AND historyEventID (both required). NOT for: listing all history events, job change details, general worker profile. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: single.

Use this to get all organizations a specific worker belongs to. User says: which orgs is this employee in, list worker's organizations, what departments does this person belong to, employee org memberships, get cost centers for employee, worker's business units, fetch all orgs for a worker. Needs: workerID (required), limit and offset optional. NOT for: a single org record, all orgs in tenant, supervisory orgs managed by worker. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: collection.

Use this to retrieve one specific organization record for a worker by org ID. User says: get one org entry for this employee, retrieve a specific org membership for worker, fetch a particular organization for worker by org ID. Needs: workerID AND orgSubresourceID (both required). NOT for: listing all orgs for worker, all orgs in tenant, supervisory orgs. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: single.

Use this to list all supervisory organizations managed by a specific worker (manager perspective). User says: which teams does this manager manage, supervisory orgs for manager, list orgs managed by this person, what does this manager oversee, manager's teams, show managed supervisory orgs. Needs: workerID (required), limit and offset optional. NOT for: orgs a worker belongs to (use worker/organizations), a single supervisory org, direct reports list. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: collection.

Use this to retrieve one specific supervisory organization managed by a worker. User says: get one supervisory org for this manager, retrieve a specific team managed by person, fetch a particular supervisory org by ID for worker. Needs: workerID AND supervisoryOrgID (both required). NOT for: all supervisory orgs for manager, all workers under a supervisory org, general org listing. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: single.

Use this to list all direct reports of a specific worker or manager. User says: who reports to this person, list direct reports, get team members, show subordinates, fetch reportees, who does this manager manage, employee's team, show people under this manager. Needs: workerID (required), limit and offset optional. NOT for: supervisory orgs managed, org memberships, a single direct report record. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: collection.

Use this to retrieve one specific direct report entry for a worker by its ID. User says: get one direct report record, fetch a specific subordinate entry by ID, retrieve a particular direct report. Needs: workerID AND directReportSubresourceID (both required). NOT for: all direct reports for manager, supervisory org list, general worker profile. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: single.

Use this to retrieve all pending inbox tasks or action items for a worker. User says: show my inbox tasks, list pending tasks, what actions does this worker have, get to-do items, pending approvals for employee, worker action items, inbox notifications, what needs my attention. Needs: workerID (required), limit and offset optional. NOT for: a single specific inbox task, job changes, history events. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: collection.

Use this to retrieve one specific inbox task for a worker by task ID. User says: get details of one inbox task, fetch a particular to-do item, retrieve specific action item by ID, look up one inbox task. Needs: workerID AND inboxTaskID (both required). NOT for: listing all inbox tasks, completing or acting on tasks, job changes. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: single.

Use this to retrieve all pay slips for a worker. User says: get pay slips, list payslips, show salary slips, view payroll history, fetch payment records, employee pay history, my payslips, show all pay statements, compensation payment documents. Needs: workerID (required), limit and offset optional. NOT for: a single payslip by ID (use paySlips subresourceID), compensation structure, job salary band. Domain: payroll. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: collection.

Use this to retrieve one specific pay slip for a worker by its ID. User says: get one payslip, fetch a specific pay slip by ID, retrieve a particular payment record, look up one salary slip. Needs: workerID AND paySlipID (both required). NOT for: listing all payslips, compensation structure, general worker profile. Domain: payroll. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: single.

Use this to list all time off plans or leave entitlements assigned to a worker. User says: list leave plans, get all time off plans, show PTO entitlements, what leave plans does this employee have, all absence plans for worker, fetch time off policy assignments. Needs: workerID (required), limit and offset optional. NOT for: a single time off plan (use timeOffPlans subresourceID), time off entries or requests taken, leave balance numbers. Domain: absence. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: collection.

Use this to retrieve one specific time off plan for a worker by plan ID. User says: get one leave plan, check a specific PTO plan, fetch a particular time off entitlement, view one absence plan, time off plan details for specific plan. Needs: workerID AND timeOffPlanID (both required). NOT for: all plans for worker, time off entries or requests taken, requesting new leave. Domain: absence. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: single.

Use this to list all time off requests or leave entries taken by a worker. User says: list leave taken, show time off requests, get absence history, all PTO entries, leave requests for employee, time off calendar for worker, how many days off has this person taken. Needs: workerID (required), limit and offset optional. NOT for: time off plans or entitlements (different endpoint), a single entry by ID, requesting new time off. Domain: absence. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: collection.

Use this to retrieve one specific time off entry or leave request for a worker by entry ID. User says: get one leave request, fetch specific time off entry by ID, retrieve a particular absence record, look up one time off entry. Needs: workerID AND timeOffEntryID (both required). NOT for: all entries, time off plans, leave balance totals. Domain: absence. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: single.

Use this to list all business title change history for a specific worker. User says: show title change history for employee, list all business title changes, history of job title changes for worker, get title change log, all title updates for person. Needs: workerID (required), limit and offset optional. NOT for: a single title change event (use subresourceID endpoint), creating a title change (POST), job changes like role or department. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: collection.

Use this to retrieve one specific business title change event for a worker by event ID. User says: get one title change record for employee, fetch a particular title change event by ID, retrieve specific title update. Needs: workerID AND businessTitleChangeID (both required). NOT for: listing all title changes for worker, creating a title change, standalone title change lookup without workerID. Module: workers. Action: read. Scope: single.

Use this when a MANAGER or HR admin initiates a business title change FOR another worker. User says: change this employee's title, update business title for this worker, rename position title for someone else, initiate title change for an employee, HR updating a worker's display title. Needs: workerID (the target employee) + request body with new title and effective date. Secured by: Change Business Title permission. NOT for: changing your own title (use type=me endpoint), reading title history, job or role changes. Module: workers. Action: write. Scope: manager-initiated.

Use this when a worker changes THEIR OWN business title (self-service). User says: change my own title, update my business title, I want to rename my position title, self-service title change, employee updating their own display title. Use 'me' as ID for the logged-in user. Secured by: Change My Business Title permission. NOT for: a manager changing someone else's title (use the non-type=me POST), reading title history, job or role changes. Module: workers. Action: write. Scope: self_service.

Use this to create or initiate a job change for a worker covering role, department, location, or manager change. User says: change job, transfer employee, move worker to new department, promote employee, change manager, relocate worker, update job profile, staffing change, lateral move, demote, restructure role. Needs: workerID + changeJobInput body (position, reason code, effective date). NOT for: title-only changes (use businessTitleChanges POST), reading history, listing org data. Module: workers. Action: write. Scope: staffing.
